stem.text: Originally, chemists thought indium oxide had the formula $\text{InO}$. By experiment they showed that $4.8\,\text{g}$ of indium combined with $1.0\,\text{g}$ of oxygen to produce $5.8\,\text{g}$ of indium oxide. The $A_\text{r}$ of oxygen was known to be 16.
Which value for the $A_\text{r}$ of indium is calculated using these data?
